title: The newsroom patch now follows Dinis's brief pack
headline: I read all ten pages of the newsroom's brief pack and changed the patch to match it. The menu and front page follow brief 6, there is a sourced summit page, and the gate now refuses long titles. My six roles give way to brief 4's desks, which proposes you run the desk, the journalist and the fact-checker. Nothing starts until you say go.

you_asked.said: Dinis says to refer to https://web-summit.newsroom.sgit.ai/brief/ . read the page, analyse it then action any changes to ensure that what you've created is in line with it.
you_asked.done: Read briefs 1 to 10. Patch changed: brief 6's menu and front page, a sourced summit page, brief 3's article shape, brief 8's title rule in the gate. Review changed: roles superseded by brief 4.

sections.title: 1. What changed to match the brief
items: Menu (brief 6): Latest, The summit, About. Companies, Portugal and Interviews join as their pages are built, since brief 2 says a page that does not help the reader does not ship.
Front page (brief 6): the summit first, then Latest, then Companies. The purpose line is brief 2's: what is on, for the people who are there.
A summit page: dates, Opening Night, the conference days and the venue, each sourced. The full agenda is the programme desk's job (Vicky's, in brief 4).
Articles page (brief 3): the article shape, so readers know what to expect.
The gate (brief 8): a title of 12 words or more is refused. Tested.

sections.title: 2. Where I followed brief 2 over brief 6
items: Brief 6 lists six menu items, but three pages do not exist yet. I show only the three that do, and the rest join as they ship. Dinis can say otherwise at 18:00.

next: 18:00 stand-up: Dinis on the patch, push access and the split in brief 4.
